data.one_liner: Native Dart library for creating, reading, editing, and securing PDF files.
data.what_it_does: Allows programmatic creation and modification of PDF files including text, images, tables, lists, shapes, encryption, and digital signatures without relying on Adobe Acrobat. Runs across multiple platforms including mobile, desktop, and web.
use_when: You need to generate PDF reports or invoices programmatically.
You need to read, extract text, or modify existing PDFs on device or web.
You need to digitally sign, encrypt, or decrypt PDF documents.
avoid_when: You cannot use a commercial or Syncfusion community license.
You only need to display a PDF on screen using a UI viewer widget (this package is non-UI).
strengths: Feature-rich API supporting PDF creation, editing, tables, text extraction, and digital signatures.
Cross-platform support including mobile, desktop, and web.
Does not depend on external tools or Adobe Acrobat.
weaknesses: Requires a commercial or free community license from Syncfusion.
Non-UI library, so rendering a visual view of a PDF requires additional UI components or wrappers.
data.setup_notes: Requires importing the package and ensuring a valid Syncfusion license.
